Each candidate's score is computed from term frequency against the tokenized
query. The middle of the chain: reached at one hop from 501.1, and the leaf
whose own neighbor (501.3) must be absent from 501.1's neighborhood.

Its `depends-on` cites 501.3 by its accession K-000003 — the only legal leaf
citation form (UCS-1147), so a neighborhood entry resolves it to that leaf.
